Context: 10. Fee and Honorarium

## 10. Fee and Honorarium  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part - I ]  
Fee  
1. Definition.Any remuneration for work or service rendered, received by a Government servant from a source other than the Consolidated Fund of India/ State/ Union Territory is termed as 'Fee'.  
Income from the property, dividends, interests on securities, income from literary, cultural, artistic, scientific or technological efforts, participation in sports activities as amateur do not come under the purview of the term 'fee'.
